name: Aberration Hunter
description: A githyanki wearing this amulet has Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws. Aberrations also have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against them.

name: Absolute Night
description: Blind targets that fail a Dexterity Saving Throw. Deals an additional 2d6 Piercing to certain creatures that sport multiple sets of eyes.

name: Absolute Power
brief: Deal +1d6 force damage and possibly push target back 5 m (17 ft).
description: A surge of Divine energy accompanies your swing. It deals an additional 1d6 Force damage and possibly pushes your target back 5 m (17 ft).

name: Absolute's Aegis
description: If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, all damage received from spells is reduced by 1.

name: Absolute's Bane
description: On a hit with a weapon attack, possibly inflict a -1d4 penalty to the target's Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

name: Absolute's Mercy
description: If the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand, they have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

name: Absolute's Tempest
description: If the wearer bears the Absolute's Brand, they deal 1 additional Thunder damage with Thunder damage spells and attacks.

name: Absolute's Ward
description: If the wielder bears the Absolute's Brand, they gain a +1 bonus to Saving Throws.

name: Absorb Elements
description: Absorb elemental damage once per Short Rest. Take half damage from the next elemental attack targeting you, and deal an additional 1d6 of that element type on your next attack.

name: Accretion
description: The wearer gains Arcane Charge when they deal damage with close-quarter-range spells or close-quarter-range cantrips.

name: Actor
description: You have become a true thespian. Your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Deception and Performance checks.

name: Adamantine Backlash
description: When a melee attack hits you, the attacker is sent Reeling for 2 turns.
extra_description: Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.

name: Adamantine Shield
description: When a melee attack misses you, the attacker is sent Reeling for 2 turns.
extra_description: Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.

name: Additional Spell Slot
description: You gain 1 Level 1 Spell Slot.

name: Adrenaline Rush
brief: When you Dash you gain Wrath for 3 turns.
description: When you Dash you gain Wrath for 3 turns.

name: Adroit Caster
description: Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice. Usable once per short rest.
extra_description: Cantrips require the targets to be close together, unless those cantrips are projectiles.

name: Adroit Reflexes
description: When you make an Attack Roll as a Reaction, you make it with Advantage.

name: Aegis Palms
description: When you heal a creature, it gains the effect of Blade Ward. When you Revive a creature it gains the effect of Death Ward.

id: After Death Do Us Part (passive feature)
name: After Death Do Us Part
description: When the wearer is Downed, they rise once more with half their Hit Points restored, but are gripped by Shadow Possession.

name: Agonising Blast
brief: Charisma modifier added to Eldritch Blast damage.
description: When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma Modifier to the damage it deals, unless it is negative.

name: Alert
brief: +5 to initiative and cannot be surprised.
description: You gain a +5 bonus to Initiative and can't be Surprised.

name: Ambusher
brief: Gain +1 to initiative rolls.
description: Gain a +1 bonus to Initiative Rolls.

name: Ambusher
description: Gain a +2 bonus to Initiative Rolls.

name: Ambusher's Streak
description: In combat, you deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.

name: Angelclocker Knuckles
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Arcane Absorption
description: When you kill an enemy with a melee attack, regain one of your spent 1st Level spell slots.

name: Arcane Ammunition
description: Infuse your crossbow bolts with arcane energy. Your ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Force damage.

name: Arcane Ashes
description: Whenever you deal Fire damage, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

name: Arcane Battery
description: Alleviate the arcane burden of spellcasting with the power of this staff. The next spell you cast doesn't cost a spell slot.
extra_description: You need to toggle this feature on in order to activate this effect.

name: Arcane Echomalefaction
description: When the wearer inflicts a condition upon a hostile creature, they also inflict 2 turns of Reverberation.

name: Arcane Enchantment
brief: +1 to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

name: Arcane Enchantment
description: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

name: Arcane Radiance
description: When the wearer deals spell damage while illuminated by a light source, they also inflict Radiating Orb upon the target for 2 turns.

name: Arcane Recovery
description: Replenish Spell Slots while out of combat. You cannot restore spell slots above 5th level.

name: Arcane Vampirism
brief: Healed for 1d4 when a target fails a save.
description: When the creatures affected by your spells fail any associated Saving Throws, you regain 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Arcane Vehemence
description: Once per Short Rest, you regain a Level 1 spell slot when you land a Critical Hit with the Spellthief.

name: Arcane Vivaciousness
description: You gain 8 temporary hit points after casting a spell while in melee.

name: Arcane Ward
description: The residual magic of your spells forms a ward around you that protects you from harm.
extra_description:
Each time you cast an Abjuration spell, the intensity of the ward increases by the amount of the spell's Level, up to a maximum of 2x your Wizard level.
Each time you take damage, the ward blocks an amount of damage equal to its intensity, and its intensity decreases by 1.
After each Long Rest, the ward's intensity resets, and becomes the same as your Wizard level.

name: Archery
description: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls you make with ranged Weapons.

name: Arming Enhancement
description: Gain a +2 Bonus to attack and damage rolls with weapons.

name: Armour of Agathys
description: Gain 5 temporary hit points and deal 5 Cold damage to any creature that hits you with a melee attack.

name: Armour of Shadows
description: You can cast Mage Armour on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot. Mage Armour increases your Armour Class when you are not wearing armour.
extra_description: Mage Armour increases your Armour Class when you aren't wearing armour.

name: Artificial Sight
description: The wearer can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft) and cannot be Blinded.

name: Athlete: Standing Up
description: When you are Prone, standing up uses only 1.5 m (5 ft) of your movement speed.

name: Aura of Murder
description: Enemies within 3 m (10 ft) become Vulnerable to Piercing damage, unless they are Immune to it.

name: Authority
brief: Advantage on Intimidation and Insight checks.
description: You have Advantage on Intimidation checks and Insight checks.

name: Awakened
description: You can use all of your Illithid Powers as a Bonus Action. Your resistance to the zaith'isk in the githyanki infirmary awakened this power.

name: Backbreaker
description: Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone.

name: Balance
description: Gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks

name: Balduran's Favour
description: You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws.

name: Balduran's Vitality
description: The helmet heals you 2 Hit Points at the beginning of every turn.

name: Baneful Bond
description: On a hit, possibly Bane your target.

name: Baneful Strike
description: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, the target receives a -1d4 penalty to its Saving Throw against your next spell.

name: Banishment
description: Temporarily Banish your target to another plane of existence.

name: Battle Acuity
description: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, you gain Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

name: Battlemage's Power
description: When you hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon, you gain Arcane Acuity.

name: Beast Tamer
description: You have cultivated a strong bond with animals. You can cast Find Familiar without expending a spell slot.

name: Become the Bulwark
description: You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

name: Blade Ward
description: Take only half the damage from Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing attacks.

name: Blessed Mercy
description: When you heal a creature, it gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws for 2 turns.

name: Blight
description: Deals 8d8 Necrotic damage to a target. Plants take maximum damage from this spell, and have Disadvantage on the Saving Throw against it.

name: Blightbringer
description: Attacking Gnomes or Dwarves with this weapon receives a 1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

name: Blind Immunity
description: The wearer cannot be Blinded.

name: Blinding Shot
description: Weave the lost magic of the children of Deep Duerra into your shot and possibly Blind your target.

name: Blindness
description: Blind a creature. Attack Rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage.

name: Blink-of-an-eye Bolt
description: Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon.

name: Blood Money
description: Strike out greedily, dealing an additional proficiency bonus Piercing damage per 300 gold that the target possesses. The gold will be consumed.

name: Blood Thirst
description: Unarmed and melee attacks will deal an extra 2 Necrotic damage as long as you don't have your full health. If you don't deal any damage this turn, you will take 1d4 Necrotic damage at the end of your turn.

name: Blood-Curdling Emission
description: On a hit, possibly inflict Frightened ( DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw). Gain a +1d4 bonus to attack and damage against Frightened creatures.

name: Bloodletting
description: Pierce an enemy's flesh and possible make them Bleed. Some undead and constructs can't suffer bleeding.

name: Bloodrender
description: Deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus. On a successful hit, you gain Bloodrender which lets you deal more damage at the cost of some hitpoints.

name: Blur
description: Attackers have Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you.
extra_description: Doesn't affect creatures that don't rely on sight or that can see through illusions.

name: Body Aid
description: Gain a +1 bonus to Strength Saving Throws and Ability Checks.

name: Bolstering Critical
description: When scoring a Critical Hit or killing a hostile creature, wearer gains 15 temporary hit points.

name: Bolstering Smite
description: When you apply a condition with one of your Smite spells, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier.

name: Bolt of Celestial Light
description: Frighten your target with intimidating arrows. After attacking, ranged weapon attacks made by Gontr Mael deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Bone Chill
description: Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help Downed characters. An undead target receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.

name: Booming Blade
description: Strike with your weapon, afflicting your foe with a resonance that hurts them for 1d8 Thunder when they move.
extra_description: This spell can be cast while you are Silenced.

name: Booming Blows
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Thunder damage.

name: Boon of the Raven Queen
description: While wearing the amulet, the wearer's jump and flying speed increase by 1.5 m (5 ft), and they gain the Feather Fall condition. Feather Fall's effect will persist while the wearer is Polymorphed or Wild-Shaped.

name: Booze Remedy
description: While wearing this amulet, regain 2d4 Hit Points per turn while Drunk. Additionally, increase the duration of your inebriation by 5 rounds.

name: Bounty Hunter
description: Gain Proficiency in Investigation. Creatures you hit with Ensnaring Strike (either ranged or melee) have Disadvantage on their Saving Throw.

name: Brace (Melee)
description: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement. For the rest of your turn, roll melee damage twice and use the highest result.

name: Brace (Ranged)
description: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement. For the rest of your turn, roll ranged damage twice and use the highest result.

name: Break the Unbroken
description: Deals an additional 1d8 Piercing to targets that still have all their hit points.

name: Break the Unbroken
description: Deals an additional 1d10 Piercing to targets that still have all their hit points.

name: Breezeswift Speed
description: While using Step of the Wind, your next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

name: Browbeaten
description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to spell save DC while Threatened.

name: Bull's Strength
description: You gain Bull's Strength and increase your Strength by 2, to a maximum of 20.

name: Burned Alive
description: Deals an additional 1d4 Weapon damage to Burning targets.

name: Burning Fury
description: When dealing Fire damage, the wearer deals an additional 1 Fire.

name: Burning Hands
description: Each flammable target is hit with 3d6 Fire damage.

name: Burst of Speed
description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, their Movement Speed is increased by 3 m (10 ft).

name: Bursting Sinew
description: Explode a corpse, causing it to impale those around it.

name: Call Lightning
description: Lightning strikes all targets within the area of effect for 3d10 Lightning damage. Then for 10 turns, you can call down lightning again without expending a spell slot.

name: Callous Glow
description: The wearer deals an additional 2 points of Radiant damage against creatures that are illuminated.

name: Caretaker's Care
brief: Acidic surfaces don't affect you, and you are Resistant to Acid damage.
description: Acidic surfaces don't affect you, and you are Resistant to Acid damage.

name: Cat's Grace
description: You gain Cat's Grace and increase your Dexterity by 2, to a maximum of 20.

name: Caustic Reprisal
description: Whenever a creature deals melee damage to the wearer, that creature takes 1d4 Acid Damage.

name: Cauteriser
description: Deals an additional 1d4 Fire. On a hit, the target starts Burning unless it succeeds a Constitution Saving Throw.

name: Cautious Healer
description: When the wearer heals a creature, it automatically Disengages and won't trigger Opportunity Attacks.

name: Chaos
description: On dealing damage with this weapon, regain 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Chilling Counter
description: When a creature misses you with an attack, it receives Chilled for 2 turns.

name: Chilling Grace
description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have Resistance to Fire damage.

name: Chilling Strike
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Cold damage.

name: Cinders
description: Whenever you Burn an enemy, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

name: Cleansing Touch
description: If the wearer heals a Poisoned creature, it is no longer poisoned.

name: Cleave
description: Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals.

name: Coldbrim Chill
description: Once per turn, any condition inflicted on a target, also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost.

name: Colossal Onslaught
description: Channel your mettlesome strength and strike all creatures in a line, dealing bonus Slashing damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Colour Spray
description: Blind creatures up to a combined 33 Hit Points.

name: Combat Regeneration
description: At the beginning of your turn, the ring activates and heals you 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Concentrated Blast
description: You must be concentrating on another spell to cast this. If the target was concentrating, you heal as much as the damage that was dealt to it.
extra_description: The spell you were concentrating on will end.

name: Concussive Smash
description: Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them.

name: Conductive Strikes
description: On a hit with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains 2 Lightning Charges.

name: Cone of Cold
description: Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands.

name: Conjure Barrage
description: Channel your weapon's essence into a destructive, widespread volley.

name: Conjure Woodland Being
description: Conjure a dryad to fight alongside you. She can use Nature's Step, Entangle enemies, and Summon a wood woad.

name: Corellon's Guiding Hand
description: You gain Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows. In addition, your ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 2 damage.

name: Corrosive Strike
description: Deal additional Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. On a hit, create a pool of acid around the target which reduces Armour Class by 2.

name: Countershock
description: When the wearer takes damage while having Lightning Charges, the attacker must succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw or become Shocked.

name: Counterspell
description: Try to stop a spell being cast.
extra_description:
If it is higher level than the spell slot you used to Counterspell, you must make a check using your spellcasting ability to prevent it. The check's difficulty is equal to 10 plus the level of the spell you are trying to counter.
This spell can be cast while you are Silenced.

name: Covert Critical
description: While obscured, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

name: Crackling Resonance
description: When the wearer deals damage with a ranged Spell Attack, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation on the target(s).

name: Craterous Wounds
description: Whenever you score a Critical Hit, deal an additional 1d6 ForceDamage Rider As Source damage.

name: Create Undead
description: Create a corpse as a heinous mummy that fights by your side.

name: Crimson Weapon
brief: Ability modifier added to off-hand attacks.
description: When you make an attack with your off-hand weapon, you can add your Ability Modifier to the damage of the attack.

name: Critical Swiftness
description: After scoring a Critical Hit or killing a hostile creature, movement speed is restored to maximum.

name: Critical Virtuoso
description: When you score a Critical Hit you can spend a Bonus Action to make an additional attack.

name: Crowning Glory
description: When healing another, the wearer regains 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Crowning Strike
description: Unleash the wails of the dead that fell to your blade, and possibly instil Crown of Madness in the target.

name: Crushing Blows
description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to unarmed Attack Rolls and their unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 Bludgeoning damage.

name: Cull the Weak
description: When you bring a creature down to fewer hit points than your number of evolved illithid powers, it dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4 Psychic damage.

name: Cunning Action: Dash
description: Cover more distance this turn: double your movement speed.

name: Cunning Action: Disengage
description: Retreat safely. Moving won't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

name: Cunning Action: Hide
description: Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.

name: Cunning Brume
description: When the wearer Disengages, they also create a foggy cloud with 2 m (7 ft) radius that lasts for 1 turn.

name: Cunning Combo
description: When you shoot a target at close range, you can make an additional melee attack against it as a Reaction.
extra_description: This reaction won't trigger on a Critical Hit.

name: Damp Aegis
description: During Combat, once per turn, the cloak grants the wearer Water Layer Protection until the wearer takes damage.

name: Daredevil Proximity
description: Your Ranged Spell Attacks are made as melee spell attacks when you are adjacent to a hostile creature. This effect can be toggled off.

name: Darkness
description: Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

name: Darkveil Precision
description: While obscured in shadow, the wielder has a +1d4 bonus to their ranged weapon attacks.

name: Darkvision
brief: Can see in the dark up to a certain distance.
description: Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).

name: Dauntless
brief: Cannot be Frightened or afflicted with other emotion-altering conditions.
description: You can't be Frightened or afflicted with other emotion-altering conditions.

name: Dawnburst Strike
description: Deal additional Radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. On a hit, light erupts around you in a 3 m (10 ft) area. Enemies in the light must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or be Blinded.

name: Dazing Echo
description: When a creature with Reverberation deals damage to the wearer, the creature needs to make a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or become Dazed.

name: Dazing Smite
description: On a hit infused with one of your Smites, the target must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or become Dazed.

name: Dazzling Ray
description: Unleash a beam of brilliant light that Blinds all creatures in its path.
extra_description: Until the spell ends, you can recast the spell. Casting it again may possibly Burn you each time you recast it.

name: Deadly Derivation
description: When you Poison a foe, heal yourself for 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Death Drinker
description: Gain 2d10 temporary hit points when landing a killing blow on an enemy with this weapon.

name: Death's Promise
description: When the spear misses its target, the wielder's next Attack Roll against that target gains True Strike.

name: Deathbringer's Sight
brief: Darkvision up to 3 m (10 ft). Attack roll needed for critical hits reduced by 1.
description: You can see in the dark up to 3 m (10 ft). The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by one. This effect can stack.

name: Deathly Slumber
description: Deals an additional 1d4 Necrotic to creatures that are Knocked Out or Sleeping.

name: Deepen the Wound
description: The wielder gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls with this weapon when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

name: Deepflesh Slice
description: When the wielder attacks with Advantage, the attack inflicts Bleeding.

name: Defensive Attack
description: When making your first attack of the round, you can reduce this weapon's enchantment by 1 to increase your Armour Class and Saving Throw bonus by 1.

name: Defier's Rejuvenation
description: Whenever the wearer succeeds on a Saving Throw against a Spell, they regain 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Defy Villainy
description: When the wearer becomes Blinded, Paralysed or Poisoned, they automatically cast Lesser Restoration on themselves.

name: Demonspirit Aura
description:
The wearer's summoned creatures have resistance to all damage except Psychic damage.
At the start of the summoned creatures turn, it must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or be driven Mad.

name: Devil's Sight
brief: Can see in the dark, including magical darkness, up to 24 m (80 ft).
description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 24 m (80 ft).

name: Dextrous Evasion
description: When you fail a Dexterity Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to succeed instead.

name: Diamondsbane
description: If an adamantine weapon hits an object, the hit is always critical.

name: Dig Deep
description: Inflicts Shattered on hit.
extra_description: Deep Delver deals an additional 1d4 Piercing against shattered targets.

name: Disarming Strike
description: Focus your attack on your foe's hands and possibly force them to drop the weapons they are holding.

name: Disguise Self
description: Magically change all aspects of your appearance.

name: Displacement
description: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the cloak activates, granting enemies Disadvantage on Attack Rolls that target the wearer. This effect lasts until the wearer takes damage.

name: Dolor Amarus
description: When you land a Critical Hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, it deals an additional 7 damage.

name: Doom Lobber
description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls.

name: Dragonfire Fists
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Fire.

name: Dread Iron Ambush
description: While its wielder is hidden, this weapon deals an extra 1d6 Necrotic.

name: Dreadful Hewer
description: Your foes have Disadvantage on Saving Throws to resist your spells or actions that inflict Fear.

name: Dueller's Enthusiasm
description: While you are not dual-wielding and your off hand is empty, you can make an additional melee attack with The Dueller.

name: Duelling Gloves
description: While only holding one weapon in your main hand and nothing in your free hand, gain a +2 bonus to melee weapon Attack Rolls.

name: Dwarven Thrower
description: When a dwarf throws this warhammer, it deals an extra 1d8 Bludgeoning damage, or an extra 2d8 Bludgeoning damage if the target is a Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creature.

name: Edge of Darkness
description: Create a cloud of Darkness while you attack.

name: Edge of Terror
description: Each strike fills the target with a chilling dread that prevents it from regaining hit points. Undead creatures also get Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.

name: Effective Transmitter
description: While imbued with Lightning Charges, attacks against metal constructs and foes wearing metal armour gain Advantage.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: Conjure a beam of crackling energy. Deals 1d10 Force damage to a target.

name: Electric Blood
description: When the wielder deals damage using this weapon, they gain 2 Lightning Charges.

name: Electric Veins
description: When the wielder deals damage with a spell or cantrip, they gain 2 Lightning Charges.

name: Electrified Flail
description: Clout a foe with your lightning-suffused flail and Stun them.

name: Electrify Water
description: When the wearer stands in Water during combat, it becomes Electrified Water.

name: Elegant Duellist
description: While your off-hand is empty, you score a Critical Hit when rolling a 19. Moreover, you gain an additional Reaction per turn.

name: Elemental Augmentation
description: When one of your cantrips deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, add your Spellcasting Modifier to the damage dealt.

name: Elemental Infusion
description:
When you deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage using a Spell or a Cantrip, that element infuses your weapon.
Until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional 1d4 damage of that element on your first successful weapon attack.

name: Elemental Momentum
description: Whenever the wearer deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage with Spells or Cantrip, they gain Momentum for 2 turns.

name: Elemental Resonance
description: If the wielder deals Acid, Fire, Lightning, Radiant, or Necrotic damage, it becomes resistant to that damage type for 2 turns.

name: Elements of an Epoch
description: Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it also inflicts: Acid condition, Chilled condition, or Burning condition.

name: Elven Agility
description: The wearer has a +2 bonus to Initiative Rolls and Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

name: Elven Chain
description: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

name: Endurance by Fire
brief: Resistance to fire and +2 to saving throws.
description: You have Resistance to Fire damage and a +2 bonus to Saving Throws.

name: Enervating Suffusion
brief: Unarmed attacks deal +1d4 Force.
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Force damage.

name: Enhance Leap
description: Triple a creature's Jumping distance.

name: Ensnaring Strike
description: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target.
extra_description: Ensnared creatures cannot move and take 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each turn. An ally can use their Help action to try and tear away the vines.

name: Entangle
description: Vines sprout from the ground, turning it into Difficult Terrain and possibly Entangling creatures within.
extra_description: Entangled creatures cannot move. An ally can use its help action to try and tear away the vines.

name: Envenom
description: Whenever you deal Poison damage, the target needs to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned.

name: Evasion
brief: Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.
description: Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful Dexterity Saving Throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.

name: Evasive Instinct
description: You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

name: Ever Vigilant
description: When the wearer chooses to End their Rage, they gain 15 temporary hit points.

name: Exceptional Plate
brief: Take 2 less damage from Slashing, Piercing and Bludgeoning sources.
description: You take 2 less damage from Slashing, Piercing and Bludgeoning sources.

name: Executioner
description: When you kill a creature, your next Attack Roll will be a Critical Hit. Once spent, this effect refreshes after a Long Rest.

name: Exoskeletal Endurance
description: Reduce all incoming damage by 2. When the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes Constitution modifier Piercing damage.

name: Exoskeletal Reinforcement
description: Your attacks ignore Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage.

name: Exotic Material
description: Add your full Dexterity Modifier to your Armour Class. Additionally, this armour does not impose Disadvantage on Stealth Ability Checks.

name: Experienced And Deadly
description: The wearer deals additional damage equal to their Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes.

name: Exploit Weakness
brief: Inflicts vulnerability to piercing.
description: Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to Piercing damage.

name: Exquisite Focus
description: While concentrating, you add your Spellcasting Modifier to your Saving Throws and gain a +1 bonus to your Armour Class.

name: Eyebite
description: Your eyes become black corridors walled in teeth, your gaze capable of inflicting dread, sickness, or putting creatures to sleep.
extra_description: While Concentrating, you may cast Eyebite without expending a spell slot.

name: Faceless Masquerade
description: You have Advantage on Deception Checks and Persuasion Checks.

name: Faerie Fire
description: All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage.

name: Faithwarden's Stride
description: Druidic vines cannot Entangled you and do not count as difficult terrain.

name: Favoured Weapon
description: This weapon has a +1 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls.

name: Fear
description: Hostile targets drop everything and become Fearful: they have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
extra_description: If the target ends their turn where they can't see you, they can make another Saving Throw to shake off their fear.

name: Feather Fall
description: You and nearby allies gain Immunity to Falling damage.

name: Feller of Monsters
description: You have Advantage against Monstrosity type enemies.

name: Fervent Flames
description: Whenever you take Fire damage dealt by another creature, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

name: Fey Life
description: Makes it easier for the wearer to succeed on death saving throws.

name: Feywild Sparks
description: While your sorcerous Tides of Chaos feature is active, you will always trigger Wild Magic when casting spells.

name: Fiendish Fire
description: Once per turn, a creature hit by this weapon will possibly be afflicted with Faerie Fire.

name: Fiery Return
description: When you deal Fire damage with a levelled spell, you Burn yourself and gain an additional Bonus Action this round.

name: Find Familiar
description: Summon a familiar, a fey spirit that takes an animal form of your choosing

name: Fire Acuity
description: Whenever you deal Fire damage, you gain Arcane Acuity for 2 turns.

name: Fire Shield
description: Wreathe your body in flames that shed light in a 3 m (10 ft) radius, provide Resistance to Fire or Cold damage, and retaliate against melee attacks.

name: First Blood
brief: Inflicts Bleeding on targets with full HP.
description: On a hit, inflict Bleeding upon targets that have maximum Hit Points.

name: Flaming Blade
description: Immolate your blade like a phoenix wing and strike a foe with its blazing steel.
extra_description: The wielder adds their Proficiency bonus to the damage.

name: Flaming Revenge
description: On a successful Saving Throw against a foe's spell, deal 1d4 + proficiency bonus Fire damage to them.

name: Flaming Shroud
brief: Creatures that damage you within 2m (7ft) receive Burning.
description: A creature that damages the wearer within 2 m (7 ft) receives Burning.

name: Flourish
description: Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance.

name: Fly Trap
description: Chance to Ensnare target if it is not a plant or a beast.

name: Flying Strike
brief: When a githyanki casts Fly, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.
description: When a githyanki casts Fly, their next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

name: Focused Stride
brief: Upon casting a concentration spell, gains momentum for 1 turn. While concentrating, can't be knocked prone or moved by force.
description: When you cast a spell that requires Concentration, you gain Momentum for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will.

name: Fog Cloud
description: Create a cloud of dense fog to Heavily Obscure and Blind creatures within.

name: Fond Caress
description: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to receive Warding Bond from a creature wearing the matching ring.

name: Force Absorption
description: Gain 2 turns of Force Conduit when taking Slashing, Piercing, or Bludgeoning damage.

name: Forest Aegis
description: You are invested with the power of the meadows and woods of the land, and have the effect of Barkskin, increasing your Armour Class to 16.

name: Formless Slaughter
description: You gain a +1 to Attack and Damage rolls while shapeshifting or disguised.

name: Frantic Urgency
description: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain Momentum for 1 turn.

name: Friends
description: Gain Advantage on Charisma Checks against a non-hostile creature.
extra_description: This spell can be cast while you are Silenced.

name: Frightened Immunity
description: You can't be Frightened

name: Frigid Blade
description:
You add your Proficiency Bonus as Cold Damage.
When the attack hits, apply Frostbitten. The creature takes 1d4 Cold damage when making a weapon attack.

name: Fury In The Marrow
description: When you Rage, hostile creatures in a 3 m (10 ft) radius must succeed a Weapon Action DC Wisdom Saving Throw or take 2d4 Psychic damage. The targets receive half damage on a save.

name: Galvanic Currents
description: This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Lightning damage.

name: Gargantuan Cleave
description: Swing your weapon with all your might. You can attack multiple targets, dealing bonus 1d6 SlashingDamage Rider As Source damage, but become Off Balanced.

name: Genial Strider
description: The wearer's Movement Speed is unimpeded by Difficult Terrain.

name: Giantslayer
description: On a hit, double the damage from your Strength modifier. This weapon grants you Advantage on Attack Rolls against Large, Huge or Gargantuan creatures.

name: Githborn Psionic Resistance
brief: A githyanki holding this weapon has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be Charmed.
description: A githyanki holding this weapon has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws, resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be Charmed.

name: Githborn Psionic Weapon
description: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

name: Githborn Psionic Weapon
description: When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d6 Psychic damage.

name: Gleamdance Dagger: Glowing
description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft).
extra_description: Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

name: Gleamdancer
description: When this dagger is wielded in the off-hand, the wielder gains a +1 bonus to Armour Class.

name: Glorious Pointy Hat
description: You gain a bonus to your Persuasion Checks equal to your Intelligence Modifier.

name: Glyph of Warding
description: Inscribe a circle of arcane glyphs on the ground. When stepped on by an enemy the selected magical effect will trigger.

name: Goblin's Undoing
description: Goblins have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against the wielder.

name: Godswill
description: You gain an additional use of Channel Divinity Charge. Once used, it is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

name: Gontr Mael: Glowing
description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft). Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.
extra_description: Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

name: Grand Slam
description: Slam your weapon into the ground, dealing additional Thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus, thunderously impacting nearby foes and possibly pushing them away.

name: Grease
description: Cover the ground in flammable grease. It becomes Difficult Terrain and creatures within can fall Prone.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: Turn a creature Invisible. Attacks against it have Disadvantage. It attacks with Advantage.
extra_description: Invisibility breaks when you fail increasingly harder Stealth Checks on attacking, casting spells, or interacting with items.

name: Greater Kushigo Counter
description: The wearer can use a Reaction to make an Unarmed Strike against any attacker that misses.

name: Green Bed Regeneration
description: When starting your turn on Plant Growth Surface or Vine Surface regain 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Gregarious Caster
description: Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.

name: Grievous Retribution
description: When an enemy damages the wearer, the wearer gains Wrath for 2 turns.

name: Grim Irony
description: Whenever this weapon lands a critical hit, both target and attacker must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw, or be affected by fits of laughter.

name: Grip of Shadows
description: Deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage if the target is not standing in sunlight.

name: Grit
description: When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have an additional Bonus Action.

name: Guidance
description: The target gains +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.

name: Hamstring Shot
description: Shoot an enemy in the thigh and possibly reduce their movement speed by 50%.

name: Haroldish Doom
description: When dealing damage to a target with a ranged weapon, the target must succeed a Charisma Saving Throw or be Baned for 2 turns.

name: Haste
description: Target yourself or an ally to become Hastened. The creature has a +2 bonus to Armour Class, Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, its Movement Speed is doubled, and can take one additional Action per turn.

name: Headcrack
description: Lob a small payload at the target, wounding them and possibly inflicting Dazed.
extra_description: If the attack would kill the target, it falls unconscious instead.

name: Healing Word
description: Heal a creature you can see.

name: Heart of Ice
description: When dealing Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1 Cold.

name: Heartstopper
description: Smash an enemy's chest in and possibly inflict Chest Trauma.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Your weapon hits hard enough to send your target Reeling for 2 turns.

name: Heightened Awareness
description: Gain a +3 bonus to Initiative rolls and Advantage on Perception Checks.

name: Heightened Manoeuvre
description: Targets have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Manoeuvre and Weapon Actions.

name: Heightened Necromancy
brief: Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving throws against your necromancy spells.
description: Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your necromancy spells.

name: Helldusk Armour
description: You are considered Proficient with this armour while wearing it.

name: Hellflame Cleave
description: Spew hellish flames and strike your foes.

name: Hellstalker
description: Possibly inflict Burning when hitting a creature with this weapon while Hiding or Invisible.

name: Helm's Protection
description: When you heal another creature, it gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks for 2 turns.

name: Heroes' Feast
description: You and everyone around can't be Poisoned, Diseased, or Frightened (status group). Everyone's maximum Hit Points increases by 12, and they make Wisdom Saving Throws with Advantage.

name: Hex
description: Make your attacks deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target and give it Disadvantage on an Ability of your choosing.
extra_description: If the target dies before the spell ends, you can Reapply Hex to a new creature without expending a Spell Slot.

name: Hiemal Strike
description: Pierce a creature with your frost-rimed trident and Chill it.

name: High Spellcasting
brief: +1 to Spell Save DC.
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

name: High Spellcasting
description: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC.

name: Hoarfrost Balance
description: You cannot fall Prone while traversing Icy terrain.

name: Hold Monster
description: Paralyse a creature. It can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always critical hits.

name: Hold Person
description:
Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act, or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always Critical Hits.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition.

name: Homing Weapon
description: This weapon will return to its owner when thrown.

name: Hot Little Hands
description: When the wearer deals Fire damage, the target has to succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or start Burning.

name: Hunger of Hadar
description: Creatures within this black sphere are Blinded and take damage at the end of their turn and the start of their turn.
extra_description:
Creatures starting their turn in the area take 2d6 Cold damage. Creatures ending their turn in the area possibly take 2d6 Acid damage.
The area is Difficult Terrain.

name: Hunter's Eye
description: You gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls against creatures marked by Hunter's Mark, True Strike, Faerie Fire, or Guiding Bolt.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark a creature as your quarry to deal an additional 1d6 Weapon damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.
extra_description: If the target dies before the spell ends, you can use Reapply Hunter's Mark to mark a new creature.

name: Hush You!
description: Slash a target and possibly Silence it.

name: Ice Knife
description: Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10 Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6 Cold damage to anyone nearby. It leaves an Ice surface. On miss, the shard of ice still explodes.
extra_description: This spell can be cast while you are Silenced.

name: Ice Storm
description: Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing Bludgeoning and Cold damage. It also creates an Ice surface that lasts 2 turns.

name: Ichorous Corrosion
description: When the wearer deals Acid damage, they also inflict Noxious Fumes on the target(s).

name: Illithid Euphoria
description: Charm or Frighten a creature to gain a 1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

name: Illithid Protection
description: If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, they gain +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

name: Illuminating Shot
description: Fire a shimmering bolt that inflicts 1 turn of Radiating Orb upon the target.

name: Illusion Quickening
description: After hitting a creature with a weapon attack, you can cast illusion or enchantment spells as a Bonus Action.

name: Imperial Retaliation
brief: Upon a successful save, the foe that forced the save must pass an INT save or be Stunned for 1 turn.
description: When the wielder succeeds a Saving Throw, the foe that caused the throw needs to make an Intelligence Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 turn.

name: Improved Critical
brief: Roll needed for criticals reduced by 1.
description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

name: Impulse Blast
description: Knocks nearby creatures Prone after killing a target or landing a Critical Hit.

name: Incise Ligaments
description: Grind your saw's blackest teeth into an enemy's calves and possibly Slow them.

name: Infernal Acuity
description: You gain +1 bonus to Spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC.

name: Infernal Evasion
description: When you fail a Saving Throw, you may use your Reaction to succeed instead.

name: Infernal Legion
description: Grants the Infernal Legion condition while worn.

name: Infernal Retribution
brief: On a successful save, inflicts Burning on the caster that forced the save.
description: When you succeed a Saving Throw, the caster receives Burning (Orthonic) for 3 turns.

name: Infernal Sight
description: You can see in magical and ordinary darkness up to a range of 12 m (40 ft). You cannot be Blinded.

name: Infernal Touch
description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d6 Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict Bleeding.

name: Infernal Weapon
description: On a hit, this weapon deals an additional 3 Poison damage and can possibly Poison its target.

name: Inject Nostrum
description: Inject an enemy with the mysterious liquid in your syringe and possibly Poison them.

name: Innate Fortitude
description: Once per Long Rest, you can use a Reaction to make an Attack Roll or Saving Throw with Advantage.

name: Insect Plague
description: Locusts attack everyone within range, make the area Difficult Terrain, and impose Disadvantage on Perception Checks.

name: Insidious Cold
description: Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts Chilled upon the target.

name: Intense Adamantine Backlash
brief: If melee attack hits you, the Attacker is sent Reeling for 3 turns.
description: When a melee attack hits you, the Attacker is sent Reeling for 3 turns.
extra_description: Reeling creatures have a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.

name: Interplanar Slayer
description: This weapon grants a +1d4 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends, and elementals.

name: Intimate Embrace
description: One of a magical pair of rings, this allows the wearer to cast Warding Bond once per Long Rest on a creature wearing the matching ring.

name: Invisible Weapon
description: This weapon is Invisible while equipped. It has Advantage on Attack Rolls. It loses this property for 2 rounds on a missed Attack Roll. The weapon also scores a critical hit when rolling a 19.

name: Ironvine
description: While the wielder is holding a weapon empowered with Shillelagh, and when they are hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes Piercing Damage equal to the wielder's Wisdom modifier.

name: It's All In The Wrists
description: This weapon has the Thrown property and deals an additional 1d4 Thunder damage when thrown.

name: Keen Attack
description: The wielder doubles their Proficiency Bonus when rolling ranged attacks with this weapon, unless they have Disadvantage.

name: Keeper of the Veil
description: You specialise in hunting creatures from other planes of existence. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can grant protection against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

name: Kushigo Counter
description: While Patient Defence is active: the wearer can use their reaction to make an unarmed strike against any attacker that misses.

name: Kushigo's Might
description: The wearer deals an additional 1d4 damage with Throw Attacks and attacks made with Improvised Weapons.

name: Lacerate
description: Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed.
extra_description: Undead and constructs can't bleed.

name: Last Stand
description: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain Wrath for 2 turns.

name: Lathander's Blessing
description: Once per Long Rest, when your hit points are reduced to 0, you regain 2d6 Hit Points. Allies within 9 m (30 ft) also regain 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Lathander's Light
description: Sheds holy light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are Blinded if they fail a DC 14 Constitution throw.

name: Lay Bare Their Weakness
description: After dealing damage with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains a +1 bonus to their spell save DC until the end of their turn.

name: Legendary Mobility
description: You gain Freedom of Movement and Longstrider.

name: Legendary Persistence
description: You gain Resistance and Blade Ward.

name: Lesser Infernal Retribution
description: When you are hit by a foe within 2 m (7 ft), it might take 1d4 Fire damage.

name: Lesser Infernal Touch
description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage, and can possibly inflict Bleeding.

id: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
name: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear
description: Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have Advantage on Saving Throws against their actions and spells.

name: Lethal Weapon
description: This weapon ignores resistance to Bludgeoning damage.

name: Lethal Weapon
description: This weapon ignores Resistance to Slashing damage.

name: Liberated Spellcasting
description: When you kill a creature, you can cast a Level 1 spell without expending a spell slot.

name: Lickspittle's Alertness
description: At the start of combat, the wearer gains Momentum equal to their Charisma Modifier.

name: Life Essence Harvest
description: When the wielder kills a hostile creature with a spell, they greedily absorb its energy and gain Life Essence until their next Long Rest.

name: Life Stealing Critical
description: On a Critical Hit, the target takes an extra 10 NecroticDamage Rider As Source damage as long as it isn't a construct or an undead. You also gain 10 temporary hit points.

name: Lifecharger
description: When the wearer gains Lightning Charges, they also gain 3 Temporary Hit Points. The temporary hit points disappear if the wearer runs out of Lightning Charges.

name: Lightning Strikes
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Lightning.

name: Lofty Sorcery
description: Grants an additional sorcery point to the wearer, which is restored on long rest along with your normal sorcery points.

name: Longstrider
description: Increase a creature's Movement Speed by 3 m (10 ft).

name: Loving Protection
description: Once per Short Rest, if you are below 50% Hit Points and take damage, you gain 8 temporary hit points.

name: Lunar Bestial Fortitude
description: You have a +2 bonus to Armour Class. You also have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells. This effect persists while using your druidic Wild Shape ability.

name: Lunar Bestial Vitality
description: You gain 22 temporary hit points after casting Wild Shape. While those temporary hit points are active reduce all incoming damage by 1.

name: Mage Armour
description: Surround an unarmoured creature in a protective magical force. Its Armour Class increases to 13 + its Dexterity modifier.
extra_description: This effect does not stack with Unarmoured Defence.

name: Mage Hand
description: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate and interact with objects.

name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
description: When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is invisible and permanent.

name: Magic Missile
description:
Create three darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target.
The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually.

name: Magical Durability
description: The wielder has a +1 bonus to Saving Throws against spells.

name: Magical Durability
description: The wielder has a +2 bonus to Saving Throws against spells.

name: Magical Plate
description: All incoming damage is reduced by 1

name: Magical Plate
description: All incoming damage is reduced by 2.

name: Maiming Strike
description: Possibly Maims your target. They can't move.
extra_description: Flying creatures can't be Maimed.

name: Malefic Excretion
description: Your weapon attacks also deal 2 Acid damage.

name: Malefic Funghi
description: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and when dealing Necrotic damage, they deal an additional 1 Necrotic damage.

name: Marksmanship
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Ranged Attack Rolls and Thrown Attack Rolls.

name: Martial Bravery
description: Your weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 damage while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: Unleash a soothing hum of energy that heals you and nearby allies.

name: Melee Caster
brief: Uses spellcasting modifier for attack rolls.
description: Instead of its Dexterity Modifier, the affected entity add its Spellcasting Ability Modifier to Attack Rolls.

name: Mellow Harmony
description: You make a DC 15 Performance Check, success granting all your melee weapon attacks additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 additional damage).

name: Mental Debilitation
description: When the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw against any foe's spells or actions, that foe gains Mental Fatigue.

name: Mental Inhibition
description: When a foe fails a Saving Throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

name: Mental Interference
description: When you deal Psychic damage, you also inflict Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

name: Minions of Chaos
description: You can cast Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create an illusion that compels nearby creatures to investigate.
extra_description:
You can remain hidden while casting this spell.
This spell can be cast while you are Silenced.

name: Mire the Mind
description: You can cast Slow with a Warlock spell slot.

name: Mirror Image
description: Create 3 illusory duplicates of yourself to distract attackers. Each duplicate increases your Armour Class by 3.
extra_description: Whenever you successfully evade an attack, one of the duplicates disappears.

name: Missile Snaring
description: You can intercept missiles from ranged weapon attacks with a Reaction, reducing their damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier.
extra_description: You can only reduce damage from the attack - any additional effects can't be negated.

name: Misty Step
description: Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

name: Mobile
description: Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft).

name: Mobile Shot
description: After using Dash or Disengage this turn, you can make a ranged attack as a bonus action.

name: Moderately Armoured
brief: You have proficiency with medium armour and shields.
description: You have armour proficiency with Medium armour and Shields.

name: Monsterslayer
description: This weapon deals an additional 1d4 damage against Monstrosity type foes.

name: Moonbeam
description: Call down a beam of light that damages any creatures that enters the beam or starts its turn in the light. You can use an Action to move the beam 18 m (60 ft).

name: Moonlight Butterflies
description: Strike a foe, conjuring an illusory swarm of moon-pale butterflies and gaining Advantage on attacks against the target.
extra_description: Deal additional Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus. When the target moves away from your illusion, it takes 1d6 Psychic damage.

name: Moonlight Glaive: Glowing
description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft).
extra_description: Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

name: Mountainous Poise
description: While using Patient Defence, you also benefit from the effect of Blade Ward.

name: Multitasking
description: You gain Advantage on Concentration Saving Throws.

name: Murderous Sight
brief: Darkvision up to 3 m (10 ft). +2 to Initiative.
description: You can see in the dark up to 3 m (10 ft). In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to Initiative.

name: Mystra's Blessing
description: Creatures you Bless also gain Mystra's Blessing for an additional 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls.

name: Natural Pugilist
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Melee Unarmed Attack Rolls and damage.

name: Nature's Embrace
description: Increase your Wild Shape Charge by 1. This additional charge is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

name: Nature's Vengeance
description: When the wearer stands on certain surfaces and casts a spell that deals damage, the target also suffers the surface's effects.
extra_description: Qualifying surfaces are Fire, Acid, Caustic Brine, and Simple Toxin.

name: Necromantic Evasion
description: When you fail a Saving Throw against necromancy spells or spells cast by undead foes, you can use your reaction to succeed instead.

name: Night Walker
description: The affected creature cannot be Enwebbed, Entangled, or Ensnared and cannot slip on Grease or Ice.

name: Nightsinger's Reply
description: While obscured by shadow, the wearer deals 1d4 Necrotic damage to attackers that hit them with a melee attack.

name: Nimble As a Cat
description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity Saving Throws and also increase your Jump distance by 1.5 m (5 ft).

name: Nimble Attack
description: When the wielder hits an enemy with this weapon, they gain Momentum for 2 turns.

name: Nimblefinger
description: Gnomes are granted +2 to Dexterity. Halflings and Dwarves gain +1 Dexterity.

name: Non-Lethality
description: This weapon deals only Non-Lethal Damage.

name: Nyrulna: Glowing
description: This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft).
extra_description: Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light.

name: Odd Gift
description: While wearing Khalid's Gift, Jaheira cannot be Cursed.

name: Order of Nature
description: Undead creatures that hit the wearer receive 1d6 Radiant damage. Beasts that hit the wearer deal an additional 1d6 Radiant damage.

name: Organ Rearranger
description: Reduce the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking by 1. This effect can stack. When you roll 2 damage or less, reroll the dice, taking the highest result.

name: Outer-Entity Slayer
description: When wielded against fey, fiends, or undead foes, this weapon has a +1d4 bonus to Damage and Attack Rolls.

name: Overcharge
description: Chance to Stun the wielder, unless it is a Construct.

name: Overheat
description: Release a fraction of your inner fire. All nearby creatures take damage and start Burning Fiercely.

name: Pact of the Tome
description: Your patron grants you a grimoire called "The Book of Shadows", which allows you to cast Guidance, Vicious Mockery, and Thorn Whip.

name: Paralysing Critical
description: Once per Long Rest, when scoring a Critical Hit on a humanoid, the wearer can Paralyse the target for 2 turns.

name: Part of the Flock
description: Auntie Ethel welcomes you, dearie.

name: Part the Flesh
description: Thrust forward with diabolical precision, possibly stymying your target's ability to heal.

name: Pass Without Trace
description: Call forth a veil of shadow and silence that gives you and nearby allies a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

name: Perfectly Balanced Strike
description: Send Belm snaking out with an adder's speed, the very exemplar of swiftness embodied in steel.

name: Performer
description: You gain Instruments proficiency, and your Charisma increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

name: Personal Space
description: After shoving an enemy, the wearer gains a +1 to their Armour Class until their next turn.

name: Phantasmal Force
description: Deal damage to a creature each turn. At the start of its turn, it takes Psychic damage. Each subsequent time it takes damage, the damage type of Phantasmal Force changes to match that damage type.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: Haunt a creature with illusions of its greatest fears. It takes 4d10 Psychic Damage per turn, cannot move, has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls

name: Piercing Counter
description: When the wearer has 50% hit points or less and is damaged by a melee attack, they deal 1d4 Piercing to the attacker.

name: Piercing Shot
description: Deal regular damage and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds which cause extra damage on attacks.
extra_description: Undead and constructs can't receive Gaping Wounds.

name: Piercing Strike
description: Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds.
extra_description: Undead and constructs can't receive Gaping Wounds.

name: Plant Growth
description: Make weeds burst from the ground and smother the area. Creatures moving through the weeds have their Movement Speed quartered.

name: Poison Mist
description: On a hit, deal extra Poison damage equal to your proficiency bonus and surround the target in a noxious cloud that possibly Poisons those within it.

name: Poison Trails
description: When the wearer casts a spell that deals Poison damage, it deals an additional 1d4 Poison damage.

name: Poisonous Synergy
description: While concentrating, your melee weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Poison.

name: Pommel Strike
description: Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly Daze them.

name: Potent Healing
description: Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum number of possible hit points.

name: Prepare
description: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement to deal an additional Strength modifier PhysicalDamage Rider As Source damage (minimum 1) on each successful melee weapon attack for the rest of the turn.

name: Press the Advantage
description: After scoring a critical hit, use your Bonus Action to make an additional attack.

name: Prey Decelerator
description: When this weapon lands a Critical Hit, it also Slows the target creature.

name: Prey Upon the Weak
brief: Targets at or below half their HP receive +1d4 piercing damage.
description: This weapon deals an additional 1d4 Piercing damage against targets with 50% of their hit points or fewer.

name: Prime Aegis of Fire
description: You have Resistance to Fire damage and cannot be Burned. You take 3 less damage from all sources.

name: Produce Flame
description: A flame in your hand sheds a light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius and deals 1d8 Fire damage when thrown.
extra_description: Throwing the flame immediately after you conjure it does not cost an Action. Extinguishing or throwing it on subsequent turns costs an action. The throw has a range of 9 m (30 ft).

name: Profane Scourge
description: Strike with subjugating fury, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage roll. If you hit a fiend or undead creature, deal an additional 2d6 SlashingDamage Rider As Source damage and possibly Bane it.

name: Promised Victory
description: On a hit, possibly inflict Guiding Bolt upon the target.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
description: Protect an ally against the attacks and powers of Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead.
extra_description: The targets can't be Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them, and when these creatures attack it, they have Disadvantage.

name: Psionic Backlash
brief: When an enemy casts a spell, can use a reaction to deal 1d4 Psychic per spell level.
description: When an enemy within 9 m (30 ft) casts a spell, you can use your reaction to inflict 1d4 Psychic damage to the caster per the spell's level.

name: Psionic Overload
description: Your attacks deal an additional 1d4Psychic damage, but you take 1d4Psychic damage every turn.

name: Psionic Revenge
brief: When you succeed a saving throw, the foe that caused it takes 1d4 Psychic.
description: When you succeed a Saving Throw, the foe that caused the throw takes 1d4 Psychic. Githyanki also gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

name: Psionic Ward
brief: Resistance to psychic damage. Regain 1d4 hit points on a successful saving throw against a spell.
description:
If the item detects that the wearer is gith, they have Resistance to Psychic damage.
Whenever the wearer succeeds on a Saving Throw against a spell, they regain 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Psychic Leech
description: When an enemy fails a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw against one of your spells or cantrips, you regain 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Psychic Missiles
description: Shoot an additional dart whenever you cast Magic Missile.

name: Psychic Steel Virtuoso
description: When the wielder attacks with Advantage, they deal an additional 1d8 Psychic.

name: Pushing Attack (Ranged)
description: Pushes your target back 4.5 m (15 ft).

name: Quickened Mage Hand
description: You can cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action.

name: Quickspell Flinger
description: Cantrips that cost an Action cost a Bonus Action instead. This effect can be used once per Short Rest.

name: Radiant Strike
description: On a hit, inflict 1 turn of Radiating Orb upon the target.

name: Radiating Orb Gloves
description: When the wearer deals Radiant damage, the target receives 2 turns of Radiating Orb.

name: Radiating Shockwave
description: When the wearer deals Radiant damage, they cause a Radiant Shockwave.

name: Rampart Aura
description: Costs Force Conduit to remain active. All entities with or in this aura have their movement speed halved.
extra_description: You must toggle this on in order to activate this condition.

name: Ranger Knight
brief: Gain Proficiency with History and Heavy Armour.
description: You have sworn to serve a crown or nation and seek to bring its foes to ruin. Gain Proficiency with History and Proficiency with Heavy Armour.

name: Rapid Caster
description: Each time they Dash, the wearer gains Arcane Charge for 2 turns.

name: Rat Catcher
description: Attack Rolls against beasts have Advantage.

name: Razor Gale
description: Swing your weapon in a cyclone of steel that deals razorblade-sharp damage to all enemies within range.

name: Reaper's Rigidity
brief: When activated, cannot be moved against its will, but has disadvantage on DEX saving throws.
description: When activated, you can't be moved against your will by any spell or action, but have Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

name: Rebuke of the Mighty
description: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction, dealing 2d4 Force damage and knock it Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw.

name: Redvein Savagery
description: When you make an attack with Advantage, the target takes an additional 7 PiercingDamage Rider As Source damage.

name: Refined Vaulting
description: Jump distance is increased by 1.5 m (5 ft).

name: Rejuvenating Takedown
description: Whenever the wearer knocks a creature unconscious, the wearer regains 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Relentless Revenge
description: When the wielder has 50% hit points or less, they deal an additional 1d4 Slashing damage.

name: Remedial Rhymes
description: When you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, you gain 4 temporary hit points.

name: Remove Curse
description: Touch a creature or object to remove all Curses and Hexes affecting it.

name: Repelling Blast
brief: Eldritch Blast can push away a creature up to 4.5 m (15 ft).
description: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to 4.5 m (15 ft) away from you.

name: Reposition Malefactor
description: Pulls the creature 9 m (30 ft) closer to you.

name: Revenant Scourge
description: When used against undead creatures this weapon has +1d4 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls.

name: Revitalising Strike
description: Smash into a foe, wounding them and healing your own injuries.
extra_description: On a hit, heal 1d6 Hit Points. You deal additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Ring of Veracity
description: You gain an Advantage on Insight Checks.

name: Risky Attack
description: You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls and receive Disadvantage on Saving Throws.

name: Ruintamer Heart
description: While Raging, the wearer generates 2 turns of Wrath.

name: Running Jump
description: Once per turn, after the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action, they can Jump without using a Bonus Action.

name: Rupturing
description: On a hit, the target becomes Ruptured for 3 turns.

name: Rush Attack
description: Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them Off Balance.

name: Sacred Munitions
description: Infuse your crossbow bolts with holy energy. For the rest of your turn, your ranged weapon attacks inflict Turned against undead.

name: Sanctified Weapon
description: Undead creatures struck by this weapon are possibly Turned.

name: Savage Attacker
description: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.

name: Saviour's Allure
description: You restore an additional 2 Hit Points every time you heal another creature.

name: Scarlet Remittance
description: Gain a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls, damage, and Spell Save DC for every foe you slay, up to a maximum of +3.

name: Scintillating
brief: +1 to Charisma ability checks and saving throws.
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Charisma Ability Checks and Saving Throws.

name: Scorching Strike
description: Lash out with a blazing strike and possibly Burn your target.

name: Scourge of Pests
description: Deals an additional 1d6 Fire damage to Plants, Myconids, and Small creatures.

name: Searing Blood
description: Cut into an enemy, dealing an extra Proficiency bonus Fire and 1d6 Fire damage to them, while you yourself take 1d6 Slashing damage. Additionally, the attack might cause the target to Bleed and Burn.

name: Seeking Blood
description: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

name: Seeking Spell
description: When you make a Spell Attack Roll, you can spend a Sorcery Point to gain Advantage. This costs 1 Sorcery Point per spell slot Level. Cantrips cost 1 Sorcery Point.

name: Seldom Caught Unawares
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls.

name: Seldom Caught Unawares
description: You gain a +2 bonus to Initiative rolls.

name: Selûne's Blessing
description: You gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Perception Checks.

name: Selûne's Protection
description: While the wearer has Mage Armour, each successful Saving Throw causes the source of the Saving Throw to take 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Semblance of Fey
description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

name: Sentinel Weapon
description: Gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls and Advantage on Perception Ability Checks.

name: Shadeclinger
description: While obscured, the wearer has Advantage on Saving Throws.

name: Shadespell
description: While the wearer is obscured in shadow, their spells gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC, making them more likely to succeed.

name: Shadow Blade
description: Weave a shadowy shortsword in your hand that deals 2d8 Psychic damage.
extra_description:
When you use the sword to attack a target that is in dim light or darkness, you make the Attack Roll with Advantage.
The shadow blade can be unequipped and equipped again, but must remain on the spellcaster's person.

name: Shadow Blade
description: You have Advantage on Attack Rolls against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade.

name: Shadow-Blinding
description: If you attack with Advantage, you have a chance to Blind your target.

name: Shadowsoaked Blow
description: Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6 PsychicDamage Rider As Source damage. This attack doesn't break concealment.

name: Shadowthief
brief: The wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 damage against Lightly or Heavily Obscured creatures, and creatures made of shadow.
description: The wearer's weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 damage against Lightly or Heavily Obscured creatures, and creatures made of shadow.

name: Shapeshifter Slayer
description: This weapon deals an additional 1d4 damage against shapeshifters or polymorphed creatures.

name: Shapeshifter's Boon
description: While shapeshifting or disguising yourself, gain a +1d4 bonus to all Ability Checks.

name: Shar's Blessing
description: You gain Advantage on Saving Throws while Lightly or Heavily Obscured. This weapon deals an additional 1d6 damage to creatures that are Lightly or Heavily Obscured.

name: Shar's Blessing
description: If Shar allows it, use this spear to kill Nightsong.

name: Shar's Protection
description: While the wearer has Shield of Faith active, reduce all incoming damage by 2 and reflect damage received back at the attacker, who takes 1d4 Necrotic damage.

name: Shar's Umbrae
description: While obscured, the wearer has Advantage on Stealth Checks.

name: Sharp Caster
description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die(s) for a Spell Attack, that die(s) is rerolled once.

name: Sharpened Snare
description: Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws when resisting your attacks and spells that inflict Restrained.

name: Sharpshooter: All In
description: Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are proficient with have a -5 penalty to their attack roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.

name: Sharran Veil
description: Shield of Faith also grants you a +2 to all Saving Throws.

name: Shelter
description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against Charmed.

name: Shield
description: When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile. These effects last until the start of your next turn.

name: Shield Bash
brief: When hit with a melee attack, can use a reaction to knock the attacker Prone unless they pass a DEX saving throw.
description: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw.

name: Shield Conduit
description: The shield shrouds the wearer with Force Conduit at the start of its turn in combat.

name: Shield of Thralls
description: Conjure a volatile shield around yourself or an ally, granting the target 10 temporary hit points.
extra_description: If these temporary hit points are lost due to incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly Stunning nearby foes.

name: Shocking Sting
brief: Applies Shocking Grasp on a hit.
description: On a hit, possibly Shock your target.

name: Shockwave
description: When the wearer Jumps, they deal 1d4 Thunder damage in a 3 m (10 ft) radius upon landing.

name: Shoe Slinger
description: Returns to its owner when thrown. On a hit deal an additional 2d4 Psychic damage.

name: Skinburster Force
description: When the wielder deals melee damage with this weapon, they gain 2 turns of Force Conduit.

name: Skullduggery Attack
description: Your Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d4 ForceDamage Rider As Source damage.

name: Slabjaw Determination
description: You gain 15 temporary hit points whenever you Rage.

name: Slay the Wicked
description: This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Bludgeoning damage against Fiends and Undead.

name: Slay the Wicked
description: This weapon deals an additional 1d6 Slashing damage against Fiends and Undead.

name: Slippery Slapsticky
description: When knocked Prone, a hostile creature with an Intelligence of 5 or more within 9 m (30 ft) of user must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw or become stricken with Laughter.

name: Slow
description: Alter time around up to 6 enemies to Slow them. They won't get far, they can't do much, and they're easier to hit.

name: Smite the Graceless
description: Creatures who miss their Attack Rolls against the wearer must make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Smooth Start
description: At the start of combat, the wearer gains Momentum for 3 turns.

name: Snowburst
description: When the wearer deals Cold damage, they also create a 4.5 m (15 ft) circle of Ice around the target(s).

name: Snowy Liver
description: While Drunk you have Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution Modifier at the start of your turn.

name: Soothing Songs
description: When you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Soul Catching
description: Once per turn, on an unarmed hit, you regain 10 Hit Points. Alternatively, you may forego healing to gain a +5 bonus on an Attack Roll or Saving Throw until the end of your next turn.

name: Soul Fist
description: Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d10 Force damage.

name: Soul Perception
description: Gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls, Initiative Rolls, and Perception Checks.

name: Soulbreaker
description: Rend the enemy's body and soul, dealing additional Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus, and possibly Stun them.

name: Spark Blocker
description: The wearer can't be Electrocuted.

name: Sparkswall Armour
description: The wearer has +1 to Armour Class and Saving Throws as long as they have Lightning Charges.

name: Speedy Sparks
description: When the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action in combat, they gain 3 Lightning Charges

name: Spell Amplification
description: You gain an additional Level 2 Spell Slot.

name: Spell Protection
description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells.

name: Spell Resistance
brief: Advantage on saving throws against spells.
description: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells.

name: Spell Sniper
description: The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

name: Spellguard
description: You gain Advantage on Saving Throws against spells. Spell Attack Rolls against you have Disadvantage.

name: Spellmight
description: When casting a spell that requires an Attack Roll, you can take a -5 penalty to the roll to deal an additional 1d8 damage.

name: Spider Step
description: Immune to being Enwebbed. Your Movement Speed is not affected by Web surfaces.

name: Spike Growth
description:
Shape a piece of ground into hard spikes. A creature walking on the spikes takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 1.5 m (5 ft) it moves.
The spikes are Difficult Terrain, halving a creature's Movement Speed.

name: Spiteful Thunder
description: When the wearer deals damage to a Reverberating creature, it becomes Dazed unless it succeeds a Constitution Saving Throw.

name: Splinters of a Giant's Might
