description: Increases Strength to 19.

name: Spore Sacks
description: While imbued with Symbiotic Entity, you can spread Bibberbang Spores, Timmask Spores, and Haste Spores.

name: Sprint
description: Once per turn, the wearer can reduce the duration of their Momentum by 1 turn to Sprint.

name: Staff of the Ram
description: Once per turn, the blow possibly knocks a foe back 2 m (7 ft) and Stuns them. This has no effect on dragons or Huge creatures.

name: Staunch Blessing
description:
When a creature misses the wielder with an attack, they gain a +1d4 bonus to their next Attack Roll that deals non-lethal damage.
This bonus is relinquished when the wielder deals lethal damage.

name: Steadfast
description: You cannot be forcibly moved by a foe's spells or actions, and you ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain.

name: Steadfast Strike
description: Slam into a foe, preventing them (and yourself) from being moved involuntarily.
extra_description: Deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Stealthier
description: While obscured, the wearer gains a +3 bonus to Stealth Checks.

name: Stealthy
brief: +1 to Stealth.
description: Gain a +1 bonus to Stealth Checks.

name: Stealthy Critical
description: While Hiding, the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.

name: Steel Physiology
description: Reduce incoming Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage by 1.

name: Sting The Helpless
description: A Drow wielding this weapon deals an additional 1d4 Poison against Restrained targets.

name: Stirring Execution
brief: Upon killing an enemy, allies within 9 m (30 ft) gain temporary HP based on CHA.
description: When you kill an enemy, allies within 9 m (30 ft) gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma Modifier (minimum 1).

name: Strange Conduit
description: When Concentrating on a spell, the wearer's weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Psychic damage.

name: Strength in Suffering
description: Non-Cantrip spells deal an additional 1d4 Force damage when the wearer drops to half their hit points or lower.

name: Strider Movement
description: You gain Longstrider.

name: Stun Immunity
description: You can't be Stunned.

name: Subtle Swap
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls when throwing, and swap positions with the target if they fail a DC 13 Dexterity Saving Throw.

name: Sunbeam
description: A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinds all creatures in its path.
extra_description: Until the spell ends, you can recast Sunbeam without expending a spell slot.

name: Sunwalker's Gift
description: The wearer can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).

name: Superior Material
description: You take 1 less Slashing damage.

name: Superior Material
description: You take 2 less Slashing damage.

name: Superior Padding
brief: Takes -1 bludgeoning damage.
description: You take 1 less Bludgeoning damage.

name: Superior Padding
description: You take 2 less Bludgeoning damage.

name: Superior Plate
description: You take 1 less Piercing damage.

name: Superior Plate
description: You take 2 less Piercing damage.

name: Surge Accuracy
description: When you use Action Surge, gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls for the rest of your turn.

name: Swathed in Shadow
description: While obscured by shadow, the wearer gains +1 to Saving Throws when attacked.

name: Sweet Bloodletting
description: Possibly inflict Bleeding when hitting a creature with this weapon while Hiding or Invisible.

name: Swift Strides
description: When the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action during combat, they gain Momentum for 3 turns.

name: Sword Mastery
description: You gain Proficiency with shortswords, longswords, and greatswords. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to melee Attack Rolls.

name: Synchronicity
description: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Synergetic Cantrips
description: When you deal damage with a Cantrip, you gain Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

name: Synergetic Moments
description: When you inflict a condition, gain Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
description: Leave a creature Prone with laughter, without the ability to get up.

name: Temperature Adjustment
description: You have Resistance to Fire and Cold Damage.

name: Tenacity
brief: Upon missing a melee attack, still deals bludgeoning damage equal to STR modifier or a minimum of 1.
description: When you miss a melee attack, you deal Strength Modifier Bludgeoning damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

name: The Comeback
description: When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional 3 temporary hit points.

name: The Pain Maiden's Blessing
description: After a successful attack with this dagger, the wielder receives a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws until the end of their next turn.

name: The Scourge Mistress' Bane
description: Chance to inflict upon the target a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws. If the attacker still has 50% or more hit points, they take 1d6 Piercing themselves.
extra_description: A Baned creature receives a 1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

name: The Shadow Itself
description: Once per turn when you kill an enemy, shroud yourself in primeval darkness to become Invisible for 2 turns.

name: The Water Caller
description: On a hit, inflict Wet and create a 2 m (7 ft) Water surface centred around the target.

name: Thermodynamo
description: Whenever you deal damage with this weapon, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

name: Thorn Whip
description: Pulls the creature 3 m (10 ft) closer to you.

name: Throwing Boost
description: The wearer gains a 1d4 bonus to Throw damage.

name: Throwing: Lightning Damage
description: When launched at a target, deal an additional 1d4 Lightning damage.

name: Thunderous Acuity
description: Whenever the wearer deals Thunder damage, they gain Arcane Acuity.

name: Thunderous Conversion
description: When the wearer deals Thunder, Lightning, or Radiant damage, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target(s).

name: Thunderwave
description: Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage.

name: Time Thoroughly Bided
description: The wearer gains Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

name: Tippler's Rage
description: While you are Drunk, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls. You also create a blast with each melee hit landed, dealing 1d4 Thunder damage to all creatures and objects in a radius of 3 m (10 ft), excluding yourself.

name: Titan Weapon
description: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Strength Modifier.
extra_description: The weapon only adds the modifier if it improves your chance to hit.

name: Toll the Dead
description: Ring the bell of impending doom. If the target is at full health, you deal 1d8 Necrotic damage instead.

name: Topple
description: Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone.

name: Topple the Big Folk
description: Deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus. On a hit, Large, Huge, or Gargantuan creatures take an additional 2d6 SlashingDamage Rider As Source damage and must succeed a Strength Saving Throw or fall Prone.

name: Torturous Edges
description: Tortured creatures may receive Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.

name: Treader by Twilight
description: You gain a +1 bonus to Armour Class while obscured.

name: Trephination
description: Make a burr hole into an enemy's skull and possibly knock them Prone.

name: Troubadour's Wonder
description: Your Armour Class increases by 1. In addition, if you have Bardic Inspiration, you gain 1 more use of it.

name: True Strike Riposte
description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may retaliate and gain True Strike.

name: Twist of Fortune
description: When you roll 2 or less with this weapon's damage die, reroll it and take the new result.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack.

name: Umbral Attack
description: Your weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage.

name: Uncanny Dodge
brief: Can use a reaction to reduce the damage of an incoming hit by half.
description: Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself. When an attack hits you, you only take half the usual damage.

name: Undead Bane
description: Attack rolls with this weapon have Advantage against Undead.

name: Undead Ward
description: Allied undead within 6 m (20 ft) are Resistant to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

name: Underdog's Bravery
description: The wearer gains Advantage on melee Attack Rolls while surrounded by 2 or more foes.

name: Unflinching Protection
description: When a nearby ally is targeted by an attack of any kind, you can use your Reaction to make that attack automatically miss. This effect can only be used once per Long Rest.

name: Unhampered Resistance
description: While the wielder is not wearing armour, they receive a +2 bonus to Saving Throws.

name: Unshackling Strike
description: Smite the magical bonds keeping a creature Restrained, Paralyzed, and Stunned, freeing it.

name: Unwavering
description: You ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain, and cannot be Paralysed or Restrained.

name: Unwavering Bull
description: You cannot be pushed against your will and you have an Advantage on Saving Throws against being Restrained.

name: Veil of the Wind
description: You gain a +3 m (10 ft) bonus to movement speed and jump distance. Equipping this weapon gives you Immunity to falling damage.

name: Venomous Revenge
description: Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6 Poison damage.

name: Vicious Dragon Breath
description: Enemies have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your dragonborn breath weapon.

name: Vital Conduit
description: Grants the wearer 8 temporary hit points when they cast a Spell that requires Concentration.

name: Wakefulness
description: You can't be unwillingly put to Sleep.

name: Wall of Fire
description: Create a blazing wall of fire, Burning anyone who dares stand too close. Deals Fire to anything that moves into or ends its turn in the area.

name: Wall of Stone
description:
Raise a wall of non-magical, solid stone.
The wall can be created between any two points within range as long as there is a clear path between them. It is made up of Stone Pillars with 30 HP each, immune to Psychic and vulnerable to Force and Thunder damage. Pillars block movement and line of sight.

name: War Caster: Concentration
brief: You have Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration on a spell.
description: You have Advantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration on a spell.

name: Warding Hands
description: When you use your Channel Oath Charge spells, you gain Heroism.

name: Wasteland Wanderer: Cold
brief: Gain Resistance to Cold damage.
description: You have spent endless days surviving desolate tundras. Gain resistance to Cold damage, taking only half damage from it.

name: Wasteland Wanderer: Poison
description: You have spent endless days surviving fetid swamps. Gain resistance to Poison, taking only half damage from it.

name: Watersparks
description: If the wearer starts their turn on an Electrified Water surface, they gain 3 Lightning Charges.

name: Watery Guidance
description: This weapon has Advantage against Wet creatures.

name: Watery Rejuvenation
description: If the wearer is standing in a Water surface at the start of their turn, they heal 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Weakening Strike
description: Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip.
extra_description: Creatures without weapons can't have Weak Grip.

name: Weave Eater
description: Whenever the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw against a spell, they regain 1d6 Hit Points.

name: Web
description:
Cover an area in thick, flammable webbing that can Enweb creatures within.
An ally can use its Help action to try and tear away the webs.

name: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
description: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: Strike out at all nearby foes, making separate Attack Rolls against each target.

name: Willing Whip
description: Grants Resistance to Necrotic damage. Deals an additional 1d6 NecroticDamage Rider As Source damage to nearby targets, including the wielder.

name: Winter's Clutches
description: When the wearer deals Cold damage, inflict 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target(s).

name: Witchbreaker
description: You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against concentrating creatures.

name: Withering Barrier
description: When you deal Necrotic damage, you gain 1d6 temporary hit points. If a melee attack hits you while you still have temporary hit points, you deal 1d6 Piercing to all creatures within 3 m (10 ft).

name: Withering Cut
description: On a hit with a melee weapon, use a Reaction to deal additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Wound Closure
description: When Downed, automatically stabilise at the start of the turn.

name: Writhing Dance
description: When the wearer has 50% hit points or less, they don't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

name: Xyanyde's Fire
brief: Once per short rest, can encase a target in Faerie Fire for 2 turns after missing an attack against it.

name: Yeenoghu's Gift
description:
Hitting an enemy with this weapon heals the wielder for 1d6 Hit Points - but they can go Mad if they don't continue hitting an enemy each turn.
Healing through this item doesn't trigger other passives that react to healing.

name: Zephyr Break
description: Zephyr Break imitates the effects of the spell Gust of Wind while dealing thunder damage.

name: Zephyr Connection
description: This weapon will return to your hand when thrown. You cannot be forced to drop the trident. When thrown, the weapon creates an explosion that deals 3d4 ThunderDamage Rider As Source damage in a 6 m (20 ft) blast centered on the target.

name: Zephyr Flash
description: Rush forward, creating an air vortex that blasts foes and possibly inflicts Bleeding.
